pages.text: List every number up to N; cross out the multiples of 2, then of 3, then of each number still standing. What is left is prime. There are about N / ln N of them (the prime number theorem), and the crossing out takes about N ln ln N steps. A wheel skips the multiples of the first few primes before it starts, leaving only Π(1 − 1/p) of the numbers to sieve.
